driver: Wiser Heat Gateway and managed room thermostats

checks.expectation: Verify category in the refreshed Configure/Setup catalogue against the final candidate and approved supported-model inventory; retain the visible hierarchy and package identity.
Verify manufacturer in the refreshed Configure/Setup catalogue against the final candidate and approved supported-model inventory; retain the visible hierarchy and package identity.
Verify supported-models in the refreshed Configure/Setup catalogue against the final candidate and approved supported-model inventory; retain the visible hierarchy and package identity.
During initial room addition verify the displayed connection field, label, input type and required validation. Secret content remains masked and excluded from public evidence.
Inspect the appropriate installation step, description, defaults, permitted values/range and error feedback; exercise each supported option, then restore the initial setting.
Verify successful installation, exact candidate GUID/version, selected room assignment and stable managed-child identities against the configuration API and app.
Reopen Installer settings after connection and reload; confirm the previously supplied value, using private masked comparison for secrets.

On the isolated test hub, change the setting, observe reconnection and correct independent hub/device state, restore the original setting and verify recovery. Do not rotate credentials or global settings on another installed driver.
Gateway appears on Home for the pinned installed instance, including hot-water/Away enabled and disabled variants.
Gateway is absent from room pages for the pinned installed instance, including hot-water/Away enabled and disabled variants.
Expected gateway icon renders correctly for the pinned installed instance, including hot-water/Away enabled and disabled variants.
Expected gateway title renders correctly for the pinned installed instance, including hot-water/Away enabled and disabled variants.
Navigation arrow is displayed for the pinned installed instance, including hot-water/Away enabled and disabled variants.
Tile and arrow open the gateway controls for the pinned installed instance, including hot-water/Away enabled and disabled variants.
Each managed thermostat appears only in its assigned room. Bind each visible tile to its exact managed device ID and check all configured rooms.
Managed thermostat is absent from Home. Bind each visible tile to its exact managed device ID and check all configured rooms.
Thermostat icon and room-specific title render correctly. Bind each visible tile to its exact managed device ID and check all configured rooms.
Tile affordance matches its navigation-only behavior; reconcile with the conditional default-action rule. Bind each visible tile to its exact managed device ID and check all configured rooms.
Verify there is no physical default action: pressing different tile areas opens the correct controls with no device change. Check navigation-only icon/ellipsis behavior; restore the originating page.
Open this page from each supported entry point; close/back returns to the correct Home/room or parent page without sending a device command or saving uncommitted edits.

Cause each supported state change independently on the test hub; compare gateway/thermostat tile status and icon with the observed device state. Record response latency against an explicitly reviewed prompt-feedback budget and restore state.
Physically remove the isolated hub connection/power, timestamp that event, and verify every affected tile reports offline within 15 seconds. Preserve captures and independent disconnection timing.

Restore the isolated hub connection; timestamp first independently observed communication and the tile recovery. Verify valid current state and recovery latency against the reviewed prompt-feedback budget.

Compare the final candidate definition/localization with this rendered target. Exercise all visibility/enabled variants, error states and conditional schedule slots. Record the complete observed inventory; source parsing alone is insufficient.

Inspect the final candidate definitions and all runtime/configuration variants. Record NotApplicable with retained absence evidence only if no segmented-sliders exist. A framework-generated control or new definition invalidates this absence proposal.

Check name/status, operate both transitions repeatedly and rapidly, observe independent device state after each accepted action, and verify UI/device agreement. Busy disabling must not leave stale state; restore the full initial state.

Verify label, status and repeated intended response. Exercise each defined busy/disabled/error condition for its full duration and recovery; compare device feedback. For undeclared alert behavior record explicit absence evidence rather than inventing an alert.

Inspect the final candidate definitions and all runtime/configuration variants. Record NotApplicable with retained absence evidence only if no toggle-sliders exist. A framework-generated control or new definition invalidates this absence proposal.

Inspect the framework-rendered thermostat gauge, defined labels and supported bounds; independently vary reported temperature and verify display/feedback. Do not exempt native-rendered gauges solely because the XML tag is thermostat.

Verify label/icon and repeated operation of this button, with independent command/state evidence and measured feedback. Save Day and Save All Days must use isolated schedules; verify intended scope and restore all affected shared schedules/rooms.
Capture grouping, order and spacing in every visibility variant; all members must remain visually grouped and usable.

Verify labels and every supported choice. Capture the complete choice inventory and each selection result. Day/time changes affect the editor until save; schedule selection changes the assignment. Verify those intended semantics and restore original editor/hub state.

Inspect the final candidate definitions and all runtime/configuration variants. Record NotApplicable with retained absence evidence only if no button-lists exist. A framework-generated control or new definition invalidates this absence proposal.

Inspect the final candidate definitions and all runtime/configuration variants. Record NotApplicable with retained absence evidence only if no navigation-pads exist. A framework-generated control or new definition invalidates this absence proposal.

Inspect the final candidate definitions and all runtime/configuration variants. Record NotApplicable with retained absence evidence only if no driver-keypads exist. A framework-generated control or new definition invalidates this absence proposal.

Exercise every actually supported thermostat mode and its UI state; verify unsupported cool/auto controls are absent and explicitly document whether off is offered. Use the isolated room and retain measured response timings.
Set heat target to supported minimum and maximum through the actual UI; verify independent device state and restore target/mode. Use the isolated room and retain measured response timings.
Compare current temperature and gauge with an independent hub read before/after reported temperature changes. Use the isolated room and retain measured response timings.

Repeat temperatures, labels and setpoint bounds in Celsius and Fahrenheit; verify conversions against the same physical value and restore configured units. Use the isolated room and retain measured response timings.
Exercise lower/raise through min/max and error bounds in every visible slot. Validate formatting and units; changes remain uncommitted until save. Restore editor and shared schedule state.

Inspect configuration label/hint/guidance, keyboard type, numeric ranges and all declared error messages. Any field declared obscured must mask its value; independently redact known private values from retained evidence even if the driver does not mark them masked. Invalid input must not produce a connection/device command; restore valid values.
Inspect labels/descriptions and both boolean transitions in setup; record the actual framework control type. Verify resulting feature visibility/enabled state and restore initial flags.

Inspect the final candidate definitions and all runtime/configuration variants. Record NotApplicable with retained absence evidence only if no driver-confirmation-dialogs exist. A framework-generated control or new definition invalidates this absence proposal.

Inspect native selection dialog title, complete choices and cancel/back behavior. Cancel must close without change; each choice must perform only its intended selection action. Restore the original selected/editor/device state.

Repeat applicable control checks on this page/dialog in every reachable conditional state. Retain a per-control result matrix tied to the explicit target inventory, including all ten possible schedule slots and shared-schedule impact/error text.

Use independently controlled test equipment to remove power from processor, hub and network equipment for at least 60 continuous seconds. Timestamp physical loss/restoration and preserve independent evidence; a software reboot is not this test. Restore all starting state.
After the Home program loads, verify reconnection and every applicable driver function within 60 seconds using independent feedback and retained timestamps. Do not substitute reachability alone.

Use independently controlled test equipment to remove all relevant processor/hub network connectivity for at least 60 continuous seconds. Timestamp physical loss/restoration and preserve independent evidence; a software reboot is not this test. Restore all starting state.

After network connectivity returns, verify reconnection and every applicable driver function within 60 seconds using independent feedback and retained timestamps. Do not substitute reachability alone.

Observe the same Release candidate continuously for at least 24 hours. Use a reviewed periodic sampling schedule covering all applicable functions, log missing samples, connection state and latency/feedback against baseline, verify final functionality and no degradation, then restore state. Elapsed timestamps alone do not satisfy this requirement.

Remove the isolated driver instance and verify its gateway/managed children disappear from configuration and all end-user views. Capture live logs across the operation and require no attributable removal exception. Preserve unrelated installed drivers and room assignments.
